header: Monthly or yearly, and what the difference is
lead: The same Praxis plan, billed on two rhythms. Paying for a year buys two months; paying monthly buys the freedom to stop in four weeks.
note: Net figures for one practice with up to five practitioners. A yearly invoice is issued once and is not refunded pro rata if the practice leaves mid-term; a monthly one can be stopped to the end of any month.
